verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show it can be delegated tickets/feature requests via Slack, web app, or API, which theoretically lets a non-engineer PM hand off work without a formal engineering handoff, but there is no evidence of design/mockup ingestion or PM-specific workflows. Community feedback also raises significant doubts about reliability (e.g., only 13.8% of issues resolved, demos not fully matching requirements), undermining confidence that a PM could rely on it end-to-end without engineering oversight.
